justification: Inspected [core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/multi/qrcode/QRCodeMultiReader.java](//core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/multi/qrcode/QRCodeMultiReader.java#L17) and [core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/multi/qrcode/MultiQRCodeTestCase.java](//core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/multi/qrcode/MultiQRCodeTestCase.java#L17). The package has only one production class; it depends on several core ZXing types and on `com.google.zxing.multi.qrcode.detector.MultiDetector` ([QRCodeMultiReader.java:19-31, 59-61](//core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/multi/qrcode/QRCodeMultiReader.java#L19)), but the only direct in-repo use of `QRCodeMultiReader` is the package-local test class ([MultiQRCodeTestCase.java:45-56](//core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/multi/qrcode/MultiQRCodeTestCase.java#L45)). `MultiDetector` itself is only referenced from `QRCodeMultiReader` and its own package ([core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/multi/qrcode/detector/MultiDetector.java:17-52](//core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/multi/qrcode/detector/MultiDetector.java#L17)), so there is no evidence that `com.google.zxing.multi.qrcode` is a highly stable package depending on a less stable one.
